facts.fact: A TCRA presentation lists the Tanzania National Broadband Strategy 2021-2026, with key results areas on infrastructure, connectivity and devices, among the country's digital policies.
A TCRA presentation gives Tanzania's 2022 census population as 61,741,120 and 14,152,803 private households, with ICT indicators from the census.

TZA.note: The document states nothing this study asks for TZA.
The document gives no rural and urban split and no rural connection programme.
Only TCRA awareness programmes and school clubs are mentioned, not a national skills programme.

facts.fact: A TCRA presentation lists the National ICT Policy 2016, focused on human capital, broadband access and infrastructure, among Tanzania's digital policies.

TZA.note: The 85.3% figure is internet subscriptions penetration, not a share of people using the internet.
Only digital clubs in schools are mentioned, with no school internet figure.
